title: 第1353章 铸剑已成铸剑者何在第1352章 熊港
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
（感谢.拉盖.的打赏加更55，再次感谢）
就这样，熊兽人使者被科索夜感召，返回了熊兽人高层中，杜绝了一次武装冲突。
并且不知道是为了让科索夜赶紧走，还是出于愧疚心理，这之后，雄兽人们开始全力资助科索夜，给他的远航舰队提供了大量物资。
于是一个月之后，科索夜终于筹集到了足够的物资，装满了百艘船的每一个角落，远洋时机已到！
新的一天早晨，雄港的海面上，将近200艘大船，把整个港口填的满满当当！
这其中一半的船是矮人王布尼碳森送的，另一半是科索夜利用他王子的身份动员的，以及这几个月下来，自行建造的。
这些战船的质量参差不齐，总体来说，矮人王送的那100艘战船质量最好，有蒸汽机和风帆。
次之是兽人世界商人自己用的，而再次只是这段时间他们临时打造出来的，只有风帆的破船。
但不管如何，这将近200艘船，是兽人们的希望，他们会用这200艘船，开启日月神国的新篇章。
此时的海港港口，每一个角落里都站满了人，大部分人是扛枪的虎兽人士兵。
这些人排列成方阵，目光凛冽，日月黑旗被海风吹得猎猎作响。
所有人都看着海港上，一艘百米长的蒸汽风帆战舰，站在最高处的科索夜。
科索夜在高处环视一圈，下方的数万人全都看着他。
他深吸一口气，大声喊道：
“日月神国的居民们，现在是神国最危难的时刻，几个月前，我们失去了百万大军，失去了西部，大半国土，失去了我们的神王陛下！
但是各位请不要绝望，这并非我们的末路，而是新的开始！”
他略微停顿，然后继续说道：
“我和我的父亲，你们的神王陛下曾经展开过很多交谈，交谈的内容是我兽人一族的未来在何方。
神王陛下认为，旧世界已饱和，我兽人一族已经被禁锢在旧世界最贫瘠的南部沙漠。
北方的人们占据着水土丰茂的宝地，那里的土地非常肥美，可以产出海量粮食，那里的地下充满宝藏，各种矿物黄金到处都是。

那里的人们只需要简单的劳动，就可以获得大量的粮食和铁器。
而我们兽人一族，占据着这贫瘠的沙漠，付出十倍几十倍的劳动，甚至不能获得北方人一半的产出！
劳动与产出的比例严重不符合，我们已经竞争不过北方的人们了。
而这次重大失败，我们被赶出了兽人世界西方，更是证明了这一点！
旧世界已经不能承载我们的未来，继续在旧世界蹉跎，我们兽人一族只会被其他种族甩得越来越远！
所以我们必须开辟新的天地，去往新世界，在那里找到我们的未来！”
他高高抬起手，指向身后茫茫大海，指向茫茫大海后那只存在于传说中的新世界土地。
科索夜大喊道：
“我们的未来在新世界！那里有流淌着奶与蜜的土地！
只有抵达富足的新世界，我们用同样的劳动，得到同样的产出，那时我们才有资格与世界上其他种族竞争！
勇敢的战士们，不要为之前的失败伤心，因为我们必须集中所有注意力，目视前方！
未来在前方，未来在脚下，不要被失败与痛苦拖慢我们的脚步！
传我命令，扬帆，起航，前往新世界，前往我们的新未来！！”
呜呜呜！！
呜呜呜！！
content_en:
(Thanks to Lagai. for the tip and the additional update 55, thank you again)
In this way, the Orc Bear envoy was inspired by Kosoye and returned to the top brass of the Orc Bears, preventing an armed conflict.
And I don't know whether it was to make Kosoye leave quickly, or out of guilt. After that, the male orcs began to fully support Kosoye and provided a large amount of supplies to his voyage fleet.
So a month later, Kosoye finally raised enough supplies to fill every corner of a hundred ships. The time has come to go to sea!
On a new morning, there are nearly 200 large ships on the sea in Xionggang, filling the entire port to the brim!
Half of the ships were sent by the dwarf king Buni Carbonsen, and the other half were mobilized by Koso Ye using his status as a prince, and built by himself in the past few months.
The quality of these warships varies. Generally speaking, the 100 warships sent by the dwarf king are of the best quality, with steam engines and sails.
Secondly, it was used by the merchants in the orc world, and again, it was just a broken ship with only sails that they temporarily built during this period.
But no matter what, these nearly 200 ships are the hope of the orcs. They will use these 200 ships to open a new chapter in the Kingdom of the Sun and Moon.
At this time, every corner of the harbor was full of people, most of whom were tiger orc soldiers carrying guns.
These people were arranged in a square formation, with stern gazes, and the sun, moon and black flags were blown by the sea breeze.
Everyone looked at the Koso Ye, a hundred-meter-long steam sail battleship standing at the highest point in the harbor.
Kesuoye looked around from a high place, and tens of thousands of people below were all looking at him.
He took a deep breath and shouted:
"Residents of the Sun and Moon Kingdom, this is the most critical moment for the Kingdom of God. A few months ago, we lost a million troops, the west, most of the country, and our Divine King!
But please don’t despair, this is not the end for us, but a new beginning! "
He paused briefly, then continued:
“My father, your God-King, and I have had many conversations, and the content of the conversation was about the future of my orc family.
His Majesty the God King believes that the old world is saturated, and our orc clan has been imprisoned in the most barren southern desert of the old world.
People in the north occupy a treasure land with abundant water and soil. The land there is very fertile and can produce massive amounts of food. The underground there is full of treasures, and various minerals and gold are everywhere.
People there only need simple labor to obtain a large amount of food and iron tools.
And we orcs, occupying this barren desert, have to work ten times and dozens of times, and we can't even get half of the output of the northerners!
The ratio of labor to output is seriously inconsistent, and we can no longer compete with the people in the north.
And this major failure, we were driven out of the west of the orc world, proves this point!
The old world can no longer carry our future. If we continue to waste time in the old world, we orcs will only be left further and further behind by other races!
So we must open up new horizons, go to the new world, and find our future there! "
He raised his hand high and pointed to the vast sea behind him, and to the legendary new world land behind the vast sea.
Koso Ye shouted:
"Our future is in the new world! There is a land flowing with milk and honey!
Only when we reach a prosperous new world, where we use the same labor and get the same output, will we be qualified to compete with other races in the world!
Brave warriors, don’t be sad about previous failures, because we must concentrate all our attention and look ahead!
The future is ahead, the future is at our feet, don’t let failure and pain slow us down!
Send my command, raise the sails, set sail, go to the new world, to our new future! ! "
Woohoo! !
Woohoo! !
